text: OpenAI released a new AI tool that helps developers build applications faster. It supports Python and JavaScript and aims to improve developer productivity.
GreenLeaf Foods announced a new organic food delivery service in Lahore. Customers can order fresh vegetables and fruits through its mobile application.
TechNova hired 50 software engineers this month to expand its cloud computing and artificial intelligence teams.
The University of Punjab organized a technology conference where students presented projects related to robotics, machine learning, and renewable energy.
HealthPlus launched an online appointment system that allows patients to book doctor consultations and receive reminders through SMS.
A local startup introduced an electric bicycle with a longer battery life, faster charging, and a lightweight aluminum frame.
The finance department reported a 12 percent increase in quarterly revenue due to higher sales and reduced operational costs.
Researchers developed a machine learning model that identifies plant diseases from leaf images and helps farmers detect crop problems earlier.
The city administration announced a tree plantation campaign to improve air quality, increase green spaces, and reduce urban heat.
CyberSafe introduced a security training program to teach employees how to recognize phishing emails, protect passwords, and report suspicious activity.
